notes:
Terrestrial Energy Inc. (Delaware; Canadian origin, Oakville ON; HQ Charlotte NC; CIK 2019804) listed on Nasdaq as IMSR on 2025-10-29 after the business combination with HCM II Acquisition Corp closed on 2025-10-28. SPAC event is one programme (PIPE of USD50M plus about USD242M of trust cash after under 1% redemptions = "in excess of USD292M"), do not add the PIPE separately. PIPE investors are not named in the filings reached. Canada: ISED Strategic Innovation Fund, ref 033-2020-2021-Q2-811861 (Canada G&C datastore probe): amendment 0 agreement_value CAD20,000,000 (start 2019-04-01), amendment 1 on 2022-11-01 reduced it to CAD18,923,000, amendment 2 on 2026-03-31 kept CAD18,923,000 with start 2020-09-02; SIF values are authorised maxima, generally conditionally repayable, disbursements not given; recorded once at the latest value. Series A-1 preferred: the 10-K says "a USD25.8 million preferred stock private placement on July 1, 2025" (rounded); investors not named. Not recorded: USAspending shows USD795,059.10 of DOE transactions to Terrestrial Energy USA, Inc. since FY2020 (award type and dates not captured); convertible notes (about USD9.3M plus USD1.65M related parties) appear in the 10-Q cash-flow comparatives without dates; earlier private placements since 2013 are described only generically ("a series of private placements"). CORDIS, TED and BODACC probes have no Terrestrial records. Verifier: the SIF record states "this is a repayable contribution", so the event is now instrument=debt with ISED as lender (same treatment as Moltex); value is the authorised maximum after amendment 1 (CAD18.923M), disbursement unknown. Its announced_on (2019-04-01) is the agreement start date in the G&C record, not a public announcement date. Added round_label evidence for "Series A-1" (10-K equity statement); the 10-K cash-flow statement gives exact proceeds of USD25,797,201, consistent with the approx USD25.8M recorded; the date is the placement date stated in the 10-K. SPAC amount is stated in thousands in the filing ("in excess of $292,000"), i.e. USD292M, and already includes the USD50M PIPE.
MERGE 2026-10-05 (USAspending supplement): the 'USD 795,059.10 of DOE transactions since FY2020' gap is now covered award by award (three awards, USD 1,294,292.10 obligated in total, including the 2019 award). Recipient is the US subsidiary Terrestrial Energy USA, Inc. (UEI GJKZMH1MMWT7), part of the group. USAspending 'Total Outlays' is account-level outlay data reported from FY2017/FY2020 onward, so disbursed_usd can understate payments on older awards.
